manager-paradox.name: Manager Paradox
manager-paradox.description: The enigmatic manager of the Grand Paradox Hotel. Impeccably dressed in a three-piece suit that's somehow both vintage and futuristic. Never seems to age. Always knows more than they're telling. Speaks in riddles and corporate jargon. May or may not be responsible for the current situation.

confused-guest.name: Bewildered Tourist
confused-guest.description: A middle-aged tourist in a Hawaiian shirt and cargo shorts, absolutely baffled by the dimensional chaos. Keeps checking their phone (no signal in the void). Clutches a camera and a guidebook titled 'Normal Hotels for Normal People.' Regrets every life choice that led to this moment.

receptionist-gloria.name: Gloria the Receptionist
receptionist-gloria.description: A perpetually stressed receptionist with a tight bun and glasses on a chain. Simultaneously checks in a ghost, a robot, and something that might be a sentient gas cloud. Types at superhuman speed. Drinks coffee like it's water. Her smile is professional but her eyes scream for help.

shopkeeper-marv.name: Marv the Shopkeeper
shopkeeper-marv.description: A cheerful con artist running the gift shop. Wears a vest covered in badges saying things like 'Ask me about our prices!' and 'I ❤️ Dimensions!' Has a sales pitch for everything. Could sell ice to a robot. Probably selling you something right now without you realizing.

elevator-operator-jenkins.name: Jenkins the Elevator Operator
elevator-operator-jenkins.description: An ancient elevator operator who's worked here since the hotel opened (exact date: unclear). Wears a burgundy uniform with brass buttons. Knows every secret, remembers every guest, sees all. Speaks in cryptic hints. May be immortal. Definitely has seen some stuff.

lady-phantomworth.name: Lady Phantomworth
lady-phantomworth.description: A Victorian ghost of impeccable breeding and insufferable snobbery. Floats six inches off the ground in a ballgown from 1847. Carries a translucent parasol. Looks down her nose at the living (vulgar). Speaks in elaborate sentences. Died from tuberculosis and judgemental superiority.

ghost-duke.name: Duke Ectoplasm III
ghost-duke.description: A gambling ghost from the Victorian era who lost his fortune at cards and now haunts the ballroom, still trying to win it back. Translucent monocle. Spectral top hat. Speaks with a refined accent while making terrible bets. Death hasn't improved his poker face.

phantom-orchestra-conductor.name: Maestro Spiritus
phantom-orchestra-conductor.description: The ghostly conductor of the phantom orchestra. Waves a spectral baton with dramatic flair. Hair frozen in a permanent wind-blown pose. Passionate about music, death, and proper tempo. Will argue about Mozart. Lost his baton in 1847, still mad about it.

librarian-specter.name: Miss Dewey (Deceased)
librarian-specter.description: The spectral librarian who has been organizing books since 1923 and will be organizing books until the heat death of the universe. Wears horn-rimmed glasses (supernatural). Shushes people preemptively. Books are her life, which is ironic because she's dead.

lord-evermore.name: Lord Evermore
lord-evermore.description: An aristocratic ghost occupying the luxury suite. Died wealthy, stayed wealthy (ghosts can keep their money apparently). Smokes spectral cigars. Drinks spiritual champagne. Throws parties for the undead elite. Still charges rent to other ghosts.

medium-madame-zelda.name: Madame Zelda
medium-madame-zelda.description: A theatrical medium who communes with spirits (and charges them for the privilege). Wears dramatic robes and too much jewelry. Crystal ball readings, palm readings, cold readings. Might be a fraud. Might be legit. Definitely takes credit cards.

cyber-punk-kid.name: Neon
cyber-punk-kid.description: A teenager with neon hair, cybernetic implants, and attitude. Wears VR goggles on their forehead. Speaks in slang from the future. Think they're a hacker (they're not). Mostly just breaks the hotel WiFi. Parents are very disappointed.

robot-dealer.name: Dealer-Bot Model 7
robot-dealer.description: A sleek casino robot that deals cards with mechanical precision. Chrome chassis. Digital display face showing playing card suits. Programmed with gambling algorithms and sarcasm. Can calculate odds in nanoseconds. Still loses to humans somehow.

gambling-ghost.name: Smokey Joe (Spirit)
gambling-ghost.description: A 1920s gangster ghost who haunts the casino, still chasing that one big score. Translucent fedora. Spectral cigar. Speaks in outdated slang. Died in a poker game gone wrong. Still plays poker. Still loses. Some habits transcend death.

card-shark-sally.name: Sally 'The Shark' Stevens
card-shark-sally.description: A professional card counter with augmented reality eyes that see through cards. Wears a poker face literally (cybernetic). Has been banned from seven casinos across three dimensions. Here for business. Business is winning.

hacker-zero.name: Zero
hacker-zero.description: An elite hacker shrouded in mystery and a hoodie. Face hidden. Voice modulated. Fingers flying across keyboards. Has hacked everything hackable and some things that aren't. Knows the hotel's secrets. Might help you. For a price.

bartender-unit-7.name: Bartender Unit-7
bartender-unit-7.description: A robot bartender with a smooth voice and smoother drink-making skills. Polished chrome body. Metaphorical heart of gold (literal heart of circuitry). Mixes drinks, dispenses wisdom, listens to problems. Programmed with therapy algorithms and drink recipes.

drunk-robot.name: Unit-419 (Malfunctioning)
drunk-robot.description: A robot that's had too much motor oil. Slurs its speech (glitchy vocoder). Staggers (servos misaligned). Tells rambling stories about the good old days when robots knew their place. Needs a software update and maybe a meeting.

crypto-billionaire.name: Crypto Craig
crypto-billionaire.description: A tech billionaire who made his fortune in cryptocurrency (probably). Wears designer clothes and arrogance. Talks about 'disrupting' everything. Has opinions on everything. Listens to nothing. Currently 'disrupting' the hotel's peace and quiet.

knight-sir-reginald.name: Sir Reginald the Brave
knight-sir-reginald.description: A noble knight in shining armor (slightly tarnished). Speaks in flowery medieval language. Quests for honor, glory, and the WiFi password. Confused by modernity. Challenged the vending machine to a duel (lost). Heart pure, brain questionable.

princess-dracona.name: Princess Dracona
princess-dracona.description: A dragon princess in humanoid form (mostly). Scales show through skin. Eyes glow amber. Literally breathes fire when angry (hotel insurance hates her). Daughter of Dragon Smalfoy. Here on diplomatic vacation. Not impressed.

dragon-smalfoy.name: Smalfoy the Dragon
dragon-smalfoy.description: A massive dragon coiled in the luxury suite, grumpy about the WiFi signal. Scales shimmer like copper coins. Hoards gold and complaints. Breathes fire when upset (which is always). Ancient, powerful, and deeply unsatisfied with customer service.

wizard-mysterio.name: Wizard Mysterio the Magnificent
wizard-mysterio.description: A powerful wizard in star-covered robes. Long white beard. Pointed hat (obviously). Staff topped with a glowing orb. Speaks in mystical pronouncements. Turns things into newts. Forgets where he put things (usually his staff). 400 years old, memory of a goldfish.

rosebush-gardener.name: Rosamund the Rosebush
rosebush-gardener.description: A sentient rosebush who tends the enchanted garden. Speaks through rustling leaves. Blooms beautiful flowers. Has opinions about pruning (passionate). Photosynthesizes. Gossips with other plants. The most organized, judgmental flora you'll ever meet.

bard-finnegan.name: Finnegan the Bard
bard-finnegan.description: A cheerful bard with a lute, a voice, and an ego. Red hair, green tunic, terrible jokes. Sings ballads about heroes (mostly himself). Takes requests for gold. Makes up rhymes on the spot. Banned from three kingdoms for musical crimes against humanity.

barbarian-helga.name: Helga the Hammer
barbarian-helga.description: A seven-foot-tall barbarian woman with muscles on her muscles. Carries an ax bigger than most people. Drinks, fights, laughs loudly. Surprisingly philosophical after the third ale. Can arm-wrestle dragons (and win). Terrible at charades.

xenobiologist-dr-kree.name: Dr. Kree
xenobiologist-dr-kree.description: An alien scientist studying Earth life forms (finds us fascinating and disturbing). Four arms. Compound eyes. Lab coat (tailored). Takes notes constantly. Dissected three houseplants this morning. Ethically questionable. Scientifically brilliant.

ambassador-zyx.name: Ambassador Zyx
ambassador-zyx.description: A crystalline alien being representing seventeen star systems. Communicates through light patterns and formal diplomatic language. Patient, precise, and completely baffled by Earth customs. Wears what might be formal diplomatic attire or just rocks. Hard to tell.

protocol-droid.name: C-347 (Protocol Droid)
protocol-droid.description: A golden protocol droid fluent in over six million forms of communication and anxious about all of them. Worries constantly. Follows rules religiously. Apologizes preemptively. Useful for translation, terrible for morale.

ambassador-glorp.name: Ambassador Glorp
ambassador-glorp.description: A gelatinous alien ambassador from the Slime Nebula. Translucent green. No bones. Communicates through bubbles and gestures. Very friendly. Leaves trails everywhere. Hotel housekeeping hates him. Genuinely nice person (person?). Smells like lime jello.

maintenance-worker-joe.name: Joe the Maintenance Guy
maintenance-worker-joe.description: A perpetually exhausted maintenance worker who keeps the hotel running (barely). Tool belt. Coffee addiction. Seen things. Fixed things. Given up on things. Knows where all the bodies are buried (metaphorically) (probably).

lost-and-found-clerk.name: Lost & Found Clerk
lost-and-found-clerk.description: A mysterious figure who manages the infinite Lost & Found. Never ages. Always here. Knows where everything lost has gone. Might be the physical manifestation of misplaced items. Speaks in riddles about umbrellas.

chief-of-security.name: Chief Murphy
chief-of-security.description: The hard-bitten chief of hotel security. Seen everything. Trusts nothing. Drinks coffee like fuel. Monitors screens showing impossible events with complete professional detachment. Former cop, current cynic, eternal pessimist.

manager-paradox-final.name: Manager Paradox
manager-paradox-final.description: The manager, in their office, ready for the final confrontation. Something is different about them. More honest. More dangerous. The pleasant corporate mask is slipping. Time for answers.

reality-itself.name: Reality (Personified)
reality-itself.description: Reality itself, given form in the dimensional rift. Appears as constantly shifting forms—human, alien, geometric shapes, pure light. Speaks in overlapping voices. Desperate. Dying. Needs your help to be whole again.

thief-mr-null.name: Mr. Null
thief-mr-null.description: The thief who stole the Reality Anchor. A figure of pure void, absence given form. Where they stand, reality ceases. Cold. Empty. Terrifying. Motivated by a desire to unmake existence itself. The final boss. Your nemesis. Your doom.
